summary: Marti Technologies, Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 19, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing its second-quarter 2026 results. The release reports revenue of $20.0 million, a 141% year-over-year increase, a 77% gross profit margin, positive Adjusted EBITDA of $2.9 million for the first time, and a net loss of $12.5 million including an $8.3 million non-cash loss on debt extinguishment. The company increased full-year 2026 guidance to $85 million revenue and $7 million Adjusted EBITDA. This is a routine earnings report, not a special situation; no transaction terms, premiums, or deal mechanics are present.
